## Bog Mummy (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
 CE Medium undead  
 **Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +16; **Aura** despair (30 ft., paralyzed for 1d4 rounds, Will DC 16 negates)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 10, flat-footed 18 (+8 natural)  
 **hp** 88 (8d8+16 plus 8)  
 **Fort** +4; **Ref** +2; **Will** +8  
 **DR** 5/—; **Immune** undead traits; **Resist** fire 10  
 **Weaknesses** vulnerability to cold  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft., marsh move  
 **Melee slam** +10 (1d6+4 plus bog rot)  
 **Special Attacks** create spawn  

**Tactics**

 In battle, a bog mummy attacks with its fists, attempting to smash any living creature it encounters.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 17, **Dex** 10, Con—, **Int** 6, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 15  
 **Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 19  
 **Feats** Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Perception), Toughness,  
 Weapon Focus (slam)  
 **Skills** Perception +16, Stealth +11  
 **Languages** Common  

**Special Abilities**

 **Bog Rot (Su)** Supernatural disease—slam; *save* Fort DC 16; *onset* 1 day; *frequency* 1 day; *effect* 1d6 Str, Dex, Con, or Cha (determine randomly using 1d4); *cure* —.
